lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions: 'APPLIES TO ALL LINES OF BUSINESS UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED'
Medicare Advantage: NCD 100.1 and LCD L33411 reviewed
sections_in_order: Description (with Review and Analysis of Evidence)
Billing/Coding Information (CPT, HCPCS, LOINC documentation table)
criteria_location: Position Statement only (pp.2-4 approx): procedure list, 'Selection criteria' for Adults and Adolescents, an experimental/investigational list, then 'Revision bariatric surgery'. LOINC table in Billing/Coding adds documentation expectations (TSH, psychosocial assessment, BMI).
procedures_covered: BPD with or without duodenal switch
~20 listed experimental/investigational procedures (OAGB, SADI-S, ESG, balloons, TORe, two-stage, etc.)

logic.top_level: pathways (Adults, Adolescents; each an AND list whose first item is an OR of two BMI paths)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate list of procedures 'considered experimental or investigational'; no patient-level contraindications except 'Does not have a medically treatable cause for obesity'. Revision stretching due to overeating is declared not medically necessary.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Separate 'Revision bariatric surgery' section: complication list meets criteria; dilation revision needs ALL of 3 items; stretching 'due to overeating, is not considered a surgical complication'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Class III obesity (BMI ≥ 40 kg/m2), OR Class II obesity (BMI 35.0 to 39.9 kg/m2), with at least one comorbidity ... AND Does not have a medically treatable cause ... AND Has made multiple attempts ... AND Has received psychological or psychiatric evaluation
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Flat bullets alternating OR and AND with no grouping; reader must infer that (BMI-A OR BMI-B) AND the three others. A parser reading left-to-right could bind the AND items to the Class II branch only.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Revision bariatric surgery ... (e.g., obstruction, stricture, ... weight loss of 20% or more below ideal body weight) meets the definition of medical necessity.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The e.g. list is open-ended; unclear whether any other complication qualifies.

requirement_kinds.quote: Class III obesity (BMI ≥ 40 kg/m2), OR Class II obesity (BMI 35.0 to 39.9 kg/m2), with at least one comorbidity refractory to medical management
Does not have a medically treatable cause for obesity (e.g., thyroid or other endocrine disorder)
Has made multiple attempts at non-surgical weight loss (e.g., diet, exercise, medications)
Has received psychological or psychiatric evaluation with counseling as needed, prior to surgical intervention
Has attained a minimum of Tanner stage 4 or 5 pubertal development and final or near-final adult height
Psychological evaluation confirms the stability and competence of the family unit

physician history and physical (including co-morbidities and history of attempt(s) of non-surgical weight-loss program(s), ... laboratory studies (including most recent TSH level), psychosocial assessment, height, weight and BMI

Revision of a primary bariatric procedure that has failed due to dilation ... ALL of: documented by upper GI or endoscopy; initial procedure induced weight loss; compliant with nutrition and exercise program

thresholds.quote: treatment of type 2 diabetes in individuals with a BMI < 35 kg/m2

thresholds.quantity: Revision for weight loss below ideal
thresholds.quote: weight loss of 20% or more below ideal body weight

time_windows.quote: observations made six months or fewer before starting date of service

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Listed in a flat table, not mapped to criteria; investigational ones flagged only by '(investigational)' tags on 0813T, 43290, 43291, 43889, C9785. Some covered-list procedures (VBG 43842, BPD) have codes but list is by code not by procedure name.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: Only inline '(investigational)' tags; no separate list

external_dependencies.what: Medicare Advantage: NCD 100.1 and LCD L33411
external_dependencies.quote: NCDs were reviewed ... Bariatric Surgery for Treatment of Co-Morbid Conditions Related to Morbid Obesity (100.1)
Bariatric surgery may be excluded by contract.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: also known as the sexual maturity rating; breaks down the visible changes during puberty

vague_terms.quote: multiple attempts at non-surgical weight loss
vague_terms.problem: 'multiple' undefined; no duration, supervision, or documentation standard
'refractory' undefined; no duration or drug trial

vague_terms.quote: psychological or psychiatric evaluation with counseling as needed
at least one comorbidity ... (e.g., ... GERD, osteoarthritis, pseudotumor comorbidities)
vague_terms.problem: open list; 'pseudotumor comorbidities' odd phrase; no severity thresholds (no AHI, HbA1c, BP values)

extraction_hazards: Bullets are glyph characters in pdftotext output; OR/AND are at line ends and easy to lose
Adolescent bullet list is split across a page break (psych/Tanner items start on next page)
Procedure lists are bullets without codes; codes live in separate billing table
Navigation-bar text (Position Statement / Billing/Coding ...) repeated at top
interesting_structures: Experimental list is long (~20 items) and includes procedures other payers cover (SADI-S, ESG, OAGB)
Revision section contains an explicit not-medically-necessary carve-out (overeating)
Weight/BMI documentation required by LOINC table, not by criteria text

fit_to_tree.why: Mostly clean all/any with one flat-bullet OR/AND grouping problem; vague leaves ('multiple attempts', 'refractory') need judgment.
